description: This line plot illustrates the Micro F1 (%) performance of four datasets—TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, Re-TACRED, and SemEval—as a function of the number of training samples generated by LLMs, represented on the x-axis with discrete values labeled K=8, K=16, K=32, and K=64. The y-axis, labeled "Micro F1 (%)", ranges from 20 to 50 and is scaled linearly. The TACRED dataset is depicted by a blue line with circular markers, starting at approximately 23% at K=8 and rising to about 29% at K=64. The TACRED-Revisit dataset is shown with an orange line and triangle markers, beginning at around 23% at K=8 and increasing to approximately 30% at K=64. The Re-TACRED dataset is represented by a green line with diamond markers, starting at about 35% at K=8, rising to a peak of 51% at K=32, and then declining slightly to around 48% at K=64. The SemEval dataset is indicated by a red line with star markers, beginning at approximately 42% at K=8, steadily increasing to 47% at K=64.
caption_used: Micro F1 (%) of KnowPrompt using different numbers of training samples generated by LLMs. The line plot shows the performance of four datasets: TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, Re-TACRED, and SemEval. The x-axis represents the number of samples generated (K=8, K=16, K=32, K=64), while the y-axis shows Micro F1 (%) ranging from 20 to 50. TACRED and TACRED-Revisit exhibit similar trends, with TACRED-Revisit consistently outperforming TACRED by approximately 5% across all sample sizes. Re-TACRED demonstrates a steady increase, peaking at 51% at K=64, while SemEval shows a slower rate of improvement, reaching 47% at K=64. The legend in the top left corner maps each dataset to its corresponding line style and marker.
